_howTo: Test file for reminders and notifications. In the app click Import (or drag this file onto the map) and choose 'Add to my map'.
It has tasks that are overdue, due today (31 Oct 2026) and due tomorrow, so the reminders have something to show.
Delete the 'Notification test' project afterwards (select it, press Delete).
